title: Crispy Tortilla Pizza Pockets
description: Half-wraps filled with pizza sauce, pepperoni or ham and mozzarella, folded and crisped in the air fryer.

source.name: Firsttakehadrian (Instagram)
source.note: Hype or Hoax, Episode 270, rated 9.295/10 (Worth the Hype). Original inspiration: @thechefoutwest.

confidence.note: Amounts and method from the creator's caption. Not yet cooked. Italian seasoning is to taste in the source.

nutrition.note: Creator gives about 170–180 cals and 18–19g protein per pocket; lower figures shown.

items.note: Garlic, onion and herb style; extra for dipping

steps.title: Cut
steps.text: Cut the wraps ({{wraps}}) in half to make 4 pieces.

steps.title: Fill and fold
steps.text: Spread with the pizza sauce ({{sauce}}), then layer the pepperoni or ham ({{meat}}), mozzarella ({{mozzarella}}) and Italian seasoning. Fold each half securely into a pocket and give a quick spray.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Air fry for about 10 minutes until golden and crisp. Alternatively, bake at the same temperature.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve warm with extra pizza sauce for dipping.

notes.title: Oven
notes.text: The creator gives 200°C for about 10 minutes for either the air fryer or the oven.
